name: Vibes Transition Link Buffer
summary: Generate three first-frame-to-last-frame transition videos at a time, safely recover an existing Vibes session, import each result into Builder, and link it to both endpoint Cards.

steps.label: Reference, Avatar, and Scene images become eligible endpoint frames.
explanation: Builder projects image assets from its existing Reference Atlas, Avatar Store, and Scene Store into one transition-frame catalog. The projection preserves Card identity, asset identity, local path, runtime URI, and custody metadata.
Only locally readable files enter the browser claim packet. Stale paths remain provenance evidence but are not silently uploaded.

steps.label: Chosen frame pairs become deterministic queued Links.
explanation: An operator pairs a first frame with a last frame and provides the motion prompt. The pair, prompt, and model form an idempotent Link identity.
The queue claims only enough work to keep three active slots, so repeated pumps do not create duplicate provider work.

steps.label: Every valid Reference image receives one deterministic outbound transition job.
explanation: Reference frames sort by stable Card and asset identity, then form a closed ring. Each Reference becomes one first frame and the final Reference links back to the first.
Coverage reports separate ready, active, queued, failed-only, and missing References. Re-seeding the same ring is idempotent.

steps.label: A visible session check runs before every provider submission.
explanation: The browser requires the authenticated project Generate surface before transmitting frames or prompts. A public landing or login redirect records recovering and permits one visible Log In re-entry using only the existing account session.
Password, passkey, CAPTCHA, OTP, or account-choice prompts record auth-required and pause new submissions without releasing claims. The human account owner completes that boundary.

steps.label: The Codex browser uploads both frames and submits three visible generations.
explanation: Each claim packet names the exact start-frame path, end-frame path, prompt, resolution, and Builder Link ID. The browser remains human-visible because the signed-in Vibes account owns upload and generation effects.
Claimed, submitted, and generating states consume the same three-slot budget. A page refresh cannot create an extra slot because Builder—not the Vibes grid—owns concurrency truth.

steps.label: Copy link and Download return the provider output to local Builder custody.
explanation: Completion hashes and copies the downloaded video into Builder media storage. The provider link, prompt, endpoint frames, and output digest travel together.
The system-media record links the video to the first-frame Card, the last-frame Card, and the Transition Link without rewriting endpoint identity records.

steps.label: Completion emits lineage and immediately replenishes the freed slot.
explanation: An append-only completion event and merge report preserve what arrived, where it was saved, and which Cards it connects. Consumers can subscribe without treating provider history as canonical.
The completion path calls the queue pump after import. If queued work remains, exactly one replacement job is claimed, restoring the active buffer to three.

card.description: Connect two exact Hapa image Cards with a locally custodied transition video.
card.effect: Maintains three provider jobs while preserving endpoint lineage and replenishing one slot per completion.
card.risk: A provider output can become detached if the claim packet, copied link, or downloaded video is skipped.

recordRule.provider: Vibes.ai remains a generation surface, not the source of truth.
